# GRIN

> GRIN is a global academic self-publishing platform enabling authors to publish and monetize theses, essays, and research papers across multiple languages.

GRIN operates as a multilingual knowledge archive with over 260,000 academic papers available for purchase and publication. The platform supports free publication with royalty earnings, open access options with ISBN, and guaranteed flat-fee payments for academic authors worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Self-publishing
- Academic publishing
- Thesis publication
- Author royalties

## Platform Access

- [GRIN Homepage (German)](https://www.grin.com): GRIN's main German homepage providing access to 260,000+ academic papers and self-publishing services
- [GRIN Homepage (English)](https://www.grin.com/en): English version of GRIN's knowledge archive for academic and non-academic publishing
- [GRIN Homepage (Spanish)](https://www.grin.com/es): Spanish language portal for buying theses and publishing academic work freely
- [GRIN Homepage (French)](https://www.grin.com/fr): French interface for purchasing academic articles and publishing research papers

## Publishing Guides

- [Publishing Essays and Theses](https://www.grin.com/hausarbeiten-veroeffentlichen): Comprehensive guide to publishing essays and final theses with 35% royalty earnings structure
- [New Customer Upload Guide](https://www.grin.com/neukunden-upload): Step-by-step instructions for new authors uploading academic texts to the GRIN platform
- [Open Access Publishing with ISBN](https://www.grin.com/open-access-mit-isbn): Guide explaining how to publish works with Open Access rights and ISBN registration
- [Guaranteed Flat-Fee Payment Option](https://www.grin.com/garantiertes-einmalhonorar-fuer-ihre-veroeffentlichung): Information on receiving guaranteed one-time honorariums for document publication

## Legal & Copyright

- [Publishing Student Work: Legal Rights FAQ](https://www.grin.com/darf-ich-hausarbeiten-veroeffentlichen): Frequently asked questions addressing copyright concerns and legal permissions for publishing student assignments

## Specialized Imprints

- [Academic Plus](https://www.grin.com/ueber-grin/academic-plus): Specialized thesis publication imprint for advanced academic works
